decisions.reason: The future-expansion constraint does not change the currently selectable locations or homepage selector placement; future locations need not be selectable before they are added.
Making future locations addable without redesign does not alter the master website domain, which is already updated separately by the same message.
The expansion constraint is compatible with each location having its own connected Wix website and does not necessarily change that website model.
Easy addition of future locations does not change the established rule that each location has its own Wix account.
The future-location expansion constraint does not change the mobile-friendly design requirement.
Brand consistency across locations is already established by the same message, while the separate expansion constraint adds no further brand-state change.
The candidate already requires a shared layout template across sites; easy future expansion introduces no necessary additional layout-state change.
The expansion constraint does not add, remove, or alter any master-homepage information section.
Future-location addability does not change the requirement that each location maintain a separate calendar.
The site expansion constraint does not change the established per-location revenue and sales reporting isolation.
Making future locations easy to add does not change booking placement on location websites or the disabled master-site booking system.
The expansion constraint does not alter the separate payment setup and payout-isolation architecture.
